lastCompletedStory.title: DNS-based firewall rewrite (dnsmasq + ipset) in init-firewall.sh; fix LFS host

nextStoryContext: US-001 through US-004 are complete. US-005 is the next story (check prd.json for details). The devcontainer now has a dnsmasq-based firewall (init-firewall.sh) that dynamically populates the allowed-domains ipset via DNS interception, and the Dockerfile installs dnsmasq. The ALLOWED_DOMAINS list is exactly 7 entries (unchanged from US-001). The LFS host is correctly objects.githubusercontent.com. The .devcontainer/ directory is NOT embedded/vendored so no embed-vendor step is needed for devcontainer changes.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Carried from US-001/US-002: name-only -e VARNAME form confirmed. Implementation is correct.
Carried from US-003: Git credential helper protocol confirmed. x-access-token as username with GITHUB_TOKEN as password is correct for GitHub HTTPS PAT auth.

dnsmasq --ipset subdomain matching confirmed: --ipset=/github.com/setname covers github.com AND all *.github.com subdomains (same as --address matching). Sets must exist before dnsmasq starts (we do ipset create before starting dnsmasq). --no-resolv and --no-poll flags confirmed correct.
